@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import (
 	"os"

+	environmentVariableHookFunc(),
 	mapstructure.StringToTimeDurationHookFunc(),

 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToCacheBackend),
@@ -40,6 +42,28 @@ var DecodeHooks = []mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc{
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToAuthMethod),
 }
 
+var environmentVariableReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}$`)
+
+func environmentVariableHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(_ reflect.Kind, _ reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		value, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		matches := environmentVariableReference.FindStringSubmatch(value)
+		if matches == nil {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if value, ok := os.LookupEnv(matches[1]); ok {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

+func TestLoadSubstitutesEnvironmentReferences(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_GRPC_PORT", "9191")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_CACHE_TTL", "2m")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8282")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "WARN")
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`server:
+  http_port: ${CONFIG_TEST_HTTP_PORT}
+  grpc_port: ${CONFIG_TEST_GRPC_PORT}
+log:
+  level: ${CONFIG_TEST_LOG_LEVEL}
+  encoding: ${CONFIG_TEST_LOG_ENCODING}
+cache:
+  ttl: ${CONFIG_TEST_CACHE_TTL}
+`), 0600)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8282, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, 9191, result.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, "WARN", result.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, LogEncodingJSON, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
+	assert.Equal(t, 2*time.Minute, result.Config.Cache.TTL)
+}
+
+func TestLoadLeavesOtherValuesUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE", "resolved")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_EMPTY", "")
+	t.Setenv("_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE", "underscore")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_TEST_MISSING", "temporary")
+	require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv("CONFIG_TEST_MISSING"))
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name  string
+		value string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{name: "prefix", value: "prefix${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", want: "prefix${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}"},
+		{name: "suffix", value: "${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}suffix", want: "${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}suffix"},
+		{name: "two references", value: "${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", want: "${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}"},
+		{name: "starts with digit", value: "${1CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", want: "${1CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}"},
+		{name: "invalid character", value: "${CONFIG-TEST-REFERENCE}", want: "${CONFIG-TEST-REFERENCE}"},
+		{name: "missing variable", value: "${CONFIG_TEST_MISSING}", want: "${CONFIG_TEST_MISSING}"},
+		{name: "empty variable", value: "${CONFIG_TEST_EMPTY}", want: ""},
+		{name: "valid reference", value: "${CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", want: "resolved"},
+		{name: "leading underscore", value: "${_CONFIG_TEST_REFERENCE}", want: "underscore"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("log:\n  file: '"+tt.value+"'\nserver:\n  http_port: 1234\n"), 0600)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, result.Config.Log.File)
+			assert.Equal(t, 1234, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+		})
+	}
+}
